summary: New shared guide holding the duplicate-PR preflight and the commit/delivery checklist, split out of the deleted agentic-upgrade guide. The CLI now copies it into the run directory and tells the agent to follow it first. It also adds Future Defaults handling and per-major commit and grouping rules, which change what the agent does: what it commits, and when it opens a PR.
headline: Shared agent guide for duplicate checks and commit/PR delivery
reason: Docs, but the CLI ships them as live agent instructions that govern duplicate detection, commit structure and PR publishing, so wording changes alter agent behavior.
risk_signals: agent instructions control commits and PR creation
focus: Delivery rules now cover Future Defaults adoption: commits grouped by default adopted, and the version update committed first
Duplicate check now also looks for equivalent Future Defaults adoption, and the same check is repeated before publishing the PR
The file is .mdx here while the CLI copies shared.md, so confirm the docs build emits shared.md like the old agentic-upgrade.md
